reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Mild soreness is normal, especially after a new stimulus or a hard session, and light training often helps it ease. Train as planned if you feel loose once you warm up. If the soreness is sharp, worsens as you move, or makes you change how you lift, drop the load or pick a different movement, and tell me which area it is so I can work around it in your program."}
